'''dr_divot The Lollipop Guild''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[dr_divot]]
* '''Published:''' 11 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed TIGIH dr_divot LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

First off, let me explain the title.  It's from the Wizard of Oz, and is from the song sung by the munchkins when Dorothy lands her house on the witch.  Anyway, Ewoks always seem to remind me of those little munchkins, so...on to the deck...

An Ewok deck run from a There is Good in Him platform.

== Strategy ==

Why TIGIH?  Several reasons:  gets Luke with saber on the table, if he gets captured, they're soaking damage from my objective's flip side; also, if I win battles (and there is some ass-kicking tech in here to do it), my opponent will lose cards stacked on I Feel the Conflict; decent early activation (assuming no imperials come to Endor).  Anyway, the premise of the deck is to set up big drains on Endor if he doesn't come to me (via unique Ewoks and drain adding capability), and if he does come to Endor, kick some butt with destiny adders and moderate forfeit characters (C3P0 forfeits for 8 to used pile during a battle!).  The destiny adders include:  Sound the Attack, Ewok Celebration, and Close Air Support.  The forfeit of Ewoks is beefed up by the unique Ewok, and Ewok Celebration.  The space package is small, but deadly, with Han/Chewie/Falcon and Life Debt/Punch It cards you can get SIX destinies if he comes to you.  Combined with Legendary Starfighter can create problems for him in space.  Problems arise when TIE Cannons are used but, hey, you can't plan for everything. Plus, getting the Home One behemoth up in space (Haashn provide Lat Damage protection) can be intimidating.

Get sites out as soon as possible using Wuta and Mindful of the Future.  Grab Ewoks with Crix or Chirpa and drop 'em for peanuts.

Anyway, hope you enjoy.

Usually a lot of cards get deployed, so don't expect a huge differntial if you winn.  Basically, a fun deck.
